transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I feel like there’s something going on behind the scenes on my jobs, like people are plotting around my designs, and no one can convince me otherwise. It's just getting to the point where I don't know who I can trust anymore when I'm at work.
Have you noticed hearing voices or seeing things that other people do not, or is it mainly the belief that people are plotting against you?

It’s actually both. When I’m alone on a job site laying tile, I hear a man's voice right behind me saying I'm messing up and calling me a fraud. At the same time, I know the builders and homeowners are secretly emailing each other to sabotage my designs and push me out of the business.
Have you also had periods of feeling unusually high or irritable, needing much less sleep, or having more energy and racing thoughts around the same time as these beliefs and voices?

No, I’ve never had times where I felt high or had extra energy. It’s actually been the exact opposite—I feel constantly exhausted and drained, no matter how much I sleep. My mood has just been incredibly low and heavy this whole time.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the depression and exhaustion improved or went away, but the voices or beliefs about people plotting against you were still there?

Yes, late last summer my energy and appetite picked up a bit and I felt less weighed down by the heavy depression. But even during those few weeks, I was still absolutely convinced people were emailing behind my back to sabotage my designs, and I kept hearing that man's voice criticizing me on the job sites.

During the times when your depression was at its worst, did the voices or beliefs about people plotting against you happen only when you were feeling depressed, or did they also continue when your mood improved?

They definitely continued even when my mood improved. Like during that time late last summer when I felt a bit lighter, I was still completely convinced they were plotting against me and I still heard that man's voice on the job sites. The paranoia and the voices didn't go away just because the depression lifted.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you had no depression at all, and if so, did the voices or beliefs that people were plotting against you still continue during that time?

Yes, late last summer my depression lifted slightly for a few weeks, and my energy and appetite picked up so I felt less weighed down. But even during that time, the man's voice criticizing me and my belief that people were emailing behind my back to sabotage my designs continued just the same.
Have the voices and the belief that people are plotting against you been present continuously for at least 6 months, or did they start more recently?

Yes, it's actually been going on for much longer than six months—it's been almost a year now. Both the voices and the feeling that people are plotting against me started shortly after my work stress peaked last year. It has been a constant, exhausting struggle for most of this past year.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you had no depression at all, and if so, did the voices or beliefs that people were plotting against you still continue during that time?

Yes, like I mentioned, late last summer I had a few weeks where the heavy depression lifted slightly and my energy improved. But even during that time, I was still absolutely convinced people were emailing behind my back to sabotage my designs, and I still heard that man's voice on the job sites.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you had no depression at all, and if so, did the voices or beliefs that people were plotting against you still continue during that time?

Yes, late last summer was exactly like that when the heavy, weighed-down depressed feeling lifted for a few weeks and my appetite and energy improved. But even without the depression, the paranoia about people emailing behind my back and the man's voice criticizing me on job sites kept happening just as before.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the paranoia and hearing the voice completely went away, even if your depression was still present?

No, they have never completely gone away. There were a few short spells where the paranoia and the voice quieted down a bit, but they never fully disappeared, and the heavy depression has been there almost constantly.
Have there ever been any periods of at least 2 weeks when you had no hallucinations or paranoid beliefs at all, even if your depression was still present?

No, I've never had a two-week break from the voices or the paranoia. There were a few short spells where they quieted down a bit, but they never went away completely. The heavy depression has just been there almost the entire year, weighing me down.

Have there been any times when the voices or paranoid beliefs were present for at least 2 weeks even though you had no depression at all, or do the psychotic symptoms only happen when you are depressed?

Yes, late last summer I had a stretch of a few weeks where the depression lifted and I felt much lighter, but the voices and paranoia didn't stop. Even without the depression, I still heard that man's voice and believed they were plotting against me.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when you had no depression at all and no voices or paranoid beliefs, or have the psychotic symptoms always been present even when your mood improved?

No, I've never had a time when both the depression and the voices or paranoia completely went away. Late last summer, my mood and energy improved a bit and I felt less weighed down, but even during that time, the voices criticizing me and the paranoia about people plotting against me were still fully present.

Even during those times, the heavy depression, the emptiness, and my lack of interest in theater and painting remained. No, there has never been a time when all of my symptoms went away completely. Even when my mood improved slightly late last summer and the heavy depression lifted a bit, the paranoia about people emailing behind my back and the critical voice on job sites were still fully present and didn't go away.

Aside from the depression, have you noticed a clear decline in your work, self-care, or ability to think or speak clearly over the past year? For example, trouble organizing your thoughts, speaking in a confusing way, or becoming much more withdrawn than before.

Yes, my husband and clients tell me I jump all over the place when I talk now, like starting on a flooring estimate and suddenly bringing up theater or church sermons, which leaves them really confused. I also feel like a shell, struggling with basic things like showering, and I've withdrawn so much that I've lost several clients and had to hand over all our bills and household tasks to my husband.

Even during that time late last summer when my heavy depression lifted slightly, these daily struggles, along with the voices and paranoia, still persisted.
